Async two-plus to one-hour forecast retains existing focus, disables the no-op and skips it in Tab order; recovery restores disclosure semantics
Removing a focused strip returns to the weather action; removing focused weather/unit controls returns to To; existing outside focus is preserved
Failed refresh retains still-current data; expired forecast eventually disappears instead of remaining live
Missing/expired/failed/pending initial weather leaves place entry usable; denied storage reads/writes leave unit changes usable during this visit
